items.name: Greataxe
items.description: This large battle axe is too heavy to wield with only one hand. Many greataxes incorporate two blades, and they are often "bearded", having a hook at the bottom to increase the strength of their chopping power.

items.name: Lance
items.description: This spear-like weapon is used by a mounted creature to deal a great deal of damage.

items.name: Hide Armor
items.description: A mix of furs, sturdy hide, and sometimes molded boiled leather, this armor provides protection due to its layers of leather, though its bulkiness slows the wearer down and decreases mobility.

defensiveAbilities.name: Attack of Opportunity
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

defensiveAbilities.name: Deny Advantage
defensiveAbilities.description: Villamor Koth's foes struggle to pass his defenses. He isn't Off-Guard to Hidden, Undetected, or flanking creatures of his level or lower, or to creatures of his level or lower using surprise attack. However, these creatures can still help their allies flank.

defensiveAbilities.name: Raging Resistance
defensiveAbilities.description: While raging, Villamor Koth gains resistance 7 to physical weapon damage (but not physical damage from other sources, such as unarmed attacks).

offensiveAbilities.name: Axe Specialization
offensiveAbilities.description: Villamor Koth gains the critical specialization effects for all axes he wields.

offensiveAbilities.name: Furious Finish
offensiveAbilities.description: Desperate to finish the fight, Villamor Koth pours all his rage into one final blow. He makes a Strike. If it hits, he gains a circumstance bonus to damage equal to the number of rounds remaining in his Rage (maximum 10). After this Strike, his Rage immediately ends and he is Fatigued until he rests for at least 10 minutes.

offensiveAbilities.name: Giant's Lunge
offensiveAbilities.description: Villamor Koth extends his body and prepares to attack foes outside his normal reach. Until his rage ends, all his melee weapons and unarmed attacks gain reach 10. This doesn't increase the reach of any weapon or unarmed attack that already has the reach trait, but it does combine with abilities that increase his reach due to increased size.

offensiveAbilities.name: Knockback
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements Villamor Koth's last action was a successful Strike.

Effect Villamor Koth pushes his foe back 5 feet, with the effects of a successful Shove. He can follow the foe as normal for a successful shove.

offensiveAbilities.name: Rage
offensiveAbilities.description:
Villamor begins raging. He gains 19 temporary Hit Points. This frenzy lasts for 1 minute, until there are no enemies he can perceive, or until he falls Unconscious, whichever comes first. He can't voluntarily stop raging. While he is raging, he deals 12 additional Damage with melee weapons and unarmed attacks. This additional damage is halved if his weapon or unarmed attack is agile. While raging, Villamor Koth's AC is 33.

Effect: Rage
